name: agent-manager.investigation-evidence
purpose: Collect bounded run reports and friction projections for an explicit investigation subject set, preserving unknown evidence as unknown.

run_ids.description: One to eight explicit run identifiers; cohort membership is never inferred.

assumptions: agent-manager is running and its report and episode projections are reachable
run reports and episodes are bounded owner projections; transcript bodies are not read
invariants: read only; no launches, mutations, cursor movement, or recommendations
one report and one episode read per declared subject run, with at most four episode rows materialized per run
a failed subject read remains an explicit unknown and degrades the envelope to partial
the envelope is printed exactly once on every path

signals.summary: Bounded subject evidence rows with availability and projection metadata

outputs.evidence: Explicit subject run IDs and projection command identities; never transcript bodies
